title: Triathlon Pace Calculator
description: Combine swim, bike, run splits plus transitions into a total finish time.
howto: Enter your swim distance and time.
Enter T1, bike distance and time, T2, run distance and time (mm:ss or h:mm:ss).
Read each discipline's pace plus the total finish time.
Adjust any split to see how the total changes.

faqs.a: Swim pace per 100 m, bike speed in km/h, and run pace per km.
They count in your official time. Even 2 spare minutes in transition is free speed.
